user.title: Connect to Beszel
user.description: Enter the address of your Beszel Hub (for example `http://192.168.1.10:8090` or `https://beszel.example.com`). Home Assistant must be able to reach this URL.

password.title: Beszel account
password.description: Sign in with the same email/username and password you use in the Beszel web UI. A readonly user is enough. The password is only used once to create a session; Home Assistant stores the resulting access token and refreshes it automatically.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to Beszel
reauth_confirm.description: The Beszel session is missing, expired, or was rejected. Continue to sign in again with your Beszel username and password.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Beszel Hub
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS Beszel Hub URL
error.invalid_auth: Invalid username or password. Use a normal Beszel user account (not the PocketBase admin).

abort.already_configured: This Beszel Hub is already configured
abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Beszel Hub
